mathematics.assertion_tested: Each vertebrate-mitochondrial sense-codon relation equals its entailed two-CNF truth set in the existing two-bit nucleotide encoding, and the source table matches Biopython table 2.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact finite Boolean relations and RNA alphabet
mathematics.conventions: Internal complete codons only; A=11,G=10,C=01,U=00. Translation starts, incomplete stops, recoding and processing are not inferred from the internal table.
inputs: NCBI gc.prt table 2, pinned by source SHA-256
All 64 triplets for all 20 sense amino acids
All triples within each encoded relation
non_claims: No automatic transfer of standard-code numerical results
No general nucleotide-reachability theorem for overlapping frames
No mutant functional or pathogenicity inference
